summary: Wire bootstrap packaging scope regressions into native CI

delivery.outcome: Run the bootstrap packaging scope regression suite in native GitHub CI whenever its controller or tests are shipped, enabling the existing ticket452 publication without relaxing required checks.
nonGoals: No controller implementation or lease mutation
No new test exclusions, credentials, check-name or permission changes
No package version or runtime behavior change

architecture.decision: Add one explicit forward-compatible CI entry. On the current base neither feature file exists; if either the controller or its regression file exists, execute the suite and propagate failures. This disjoint CI dependency merges before ticket452 rebases onto the updated main.
interfaceChanges: One CI test invocation; the hub explicitly classifies .github/workflows/ci.yml as a public interface.
architecture.rollback: Revert only through protected review; retain the existing required test-suite wiring assertion.

commands: Parse CI YAML; run the exact new shell step with absent, present and missing-test feature fixtures
validation.evidence: Workflow bytes and actual step results are captured externally; delivered controller requires its real suite.
Native checks, required exact-head CI and independent Validator approval before merge.
